WITH day_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        report_day::date AS day_start,
        (report_day::date + INTERVAL '1 day')::timestamptz AS day_end
),
active_rentals AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.equipment_id
    FROM rentals r
    CROSS JOIN day_bounds db
    WHERE r.collected_at < db.day_end
      AND (r.returned_at IS NULL OR r.returned_at >= db.day_end)
      AND (r.cancelled_at IS NULL OR r.cancelled_at >= db.day_end)
